sections.title: Format
sections.content: Pick the output format using the format prop. Supported values: hex (default), hexa (hex with alpha), rgb, rgba (RGB with alpha), hsl, hsla (HSL with alpha). Alpha-aware formats automatically render an alpha slider in the popover.
examples: <flux:color-picker format="hex" /><flux:color-picker format="hexa" /><flux:color-picker format="rgb" /><flux:color-picker format="rgba" /><flux:color-picker format="hsl" /><flux:color-picker format="hsla" />

sections.title: Sizes
sections.content: The color picker supports three sizes that match other form components.

sections.title: Button trigger
sections.content: Use type="button" for a simpler trigger that displays the selected color and opens the popover on click. Useful for compact toolbars or swatches-only pickers where typing isn't needed.

sections.title: Custom swatches
sections.content: Replace the default 24-color Tailwind palette with your own brand colors. Pass an array of hex strings to the :swatches prop. You can also pass [value, label] pairs for accessible swatch labels.
examples: <flux:color-picker :swatches="['#ef4444', '#22c55e', '#3b82f6', '#f59e0b', '#a855f7']" /><!-- With [value, label] pairs for accessible swatch labels --><flux:color-picker :swatches="[['#ef4444', 'Red'], ['#22c55e', 'Green'], ['#3b82f6', 'Blue']]" />

sections.title: No swatches
sections.content: Pass :swatches="false" to hide the default swatch grid entirely. The popover will only show the SV area, hue slider, and hex input.

sections.title: Custom layout
sections.content: Compose flux:color-picker.area, flux:color-picker.slider, flux:color-picker.input, and flux:color-picker.swatches in any order to build a fully custom popover layout.

sections.title: Dropper
sections.content: Add the dropper prop to render a button that lets users pick a color from anywhere on the screen. Uses the browser's EyeDropper API — automatically disabled in unsupported browsers.

sections.title: Clearable
sections.content: Add the clearable prop to render a clear (X) button on the trigger when a value is set.

sections.title: Copyable
sections.content: Add the copyable prop to render a clipboard-copy button on the trigger. One click copies the color value in the configured format. Only available with the default input trigger.

sections.title: Disabled
sections.content: Prevent interaction and visually dim the trigger.
